text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Tuesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia's presidents urged NATO countries to express their opinion on membership of the three Baltic countries in the alliance more clearly.
- World-famous musician and conductor Mstislav Rostropovich arrived in Vilnius to take part in the Vilnius music festival.
- Body builder Jevgenij Gorelik, 45, from Vilnius won a silver medal in the IFBB European championship in Minsk..
- Chairman of parliament Vytautas Landsbergis doubted the quality of the supervision of commercial banks by the central bank.
- The board of the Agricultural Bank intends to propose a share capital increase of 55 milion litas to 183 million litas at a shareholder meeting on June 6.
- Foreign debt in hard currency in April was $1.199 billion, a $32.94 million increase since the beginning of the year.

- Four teams of the A league of Lithuania have threatened to withdrawn from the championship if the president of the soccer federation, Vytautas Dirmeikis, does not resign. Dirmeikis is accused of fraud.

- A poll by Baltic Surveys in April showed that trust in the president grew by five percent to 41 percent and advanced to the third place after the mass media and the church. But 84 percent of those polled said they did not trust commercial banks.
- The three Baltic countries expect that after the Madrid summit the doors of NATO will remain open for countries which do not succeed in joining the organisation during a first stage of expansion.
- The chairman of Poland's parliament Jozef Zych arrives in Lithuania on Tuesday for a one-day visit.
